'''Spear Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that flew [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] in the service of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Mini" /> The squadron's TIEs had improved defensive systems at the expense of targeting capabilities and were flown by [[TIE pilot|pilots]] trained to use group strategies and tactics.<ref name="SWPM" /><ref name="Gallery">{{WebCite|url=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/gallery.php|text=Gallery :: Star Wars Pocketmodel TCG|work=Star Wars Pocketmodel Trading Card Game|archivedate=20110726071525}} &ndash; The official website for the game identifies the attributes of the miniatures during play, including fleet affiliation, unit type, and strategies in which the representing miniature engages. These are identified through the symbols and values printed on the unit, which are defined in the [http://swpocketmodels.com/forum/index.php?topic=3058.msg46366#msg46366 rules of the game].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Spear Squadron was represented by a miniature in the [[Star Wars PocketModel TCG: Base Set#Imperial Power-up Pack|''Imperial Power-up Pack'']] supplement to the [[Star Wars PocketModel TCG: Base Set|initial release]] of the ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG]]'' on [[June 19]], [[2007]].<ref name="Release">{{WebCite|url=http://star-ranger.com/StarWarsPocketmodel.htm|text=SCN - Star Wars PocketModel TCG|date=2008-12-17|work=Starship Combat News|archivedate=20101221014858}}</ref>
